A rise in incomplete requests, abnormal connection resets, server errors, timeouts, or HTTP 4xx and 5xx responses can also be indicative of the strain caused by the DDoS traffic on the services.

Administrators should monitor these indicators to identify areas of concern and take corrective actions to mitigate the impact of the attack.
